_comment: Each scope is a claim that some check covers some population. The detector runs both commands and subtracts. A scope is registered by hand on purpose: auto-discovering which of this repo's twenty-odd *_PREFIXES tuples are scope claims would guess, and a wrong guess is silent -- the same failure mode being detected. tier=commit must be portable and fast (it runs in pre-commit); tier=periodic may read machine state.

scopes.why: capability-gate.py SCAN_ROOTS decides which tests can be DECLARED. Anything outside it is invisible to both directions of its declared-vs-actual diff, so an undeclared, unrun test there is indistinguishable from one that does not exist. Measured 2026-08-29: 312 tracked files match the gate's own patterns, 172 are in scope.

launchd-health-check.py WATCHED_PREFIXES decides which job families the watchdog can see. A family outside it dies silently and the watchdog stays green, which is exactly the shape the watchdog exists to prevent.
scopes.population: launchctl list | awk 'NR>1{print $3}' | grep -vE '^(com\.apple|application\.|0x)' | sed -E 's/\.[^.]*$//' | sort -u
scopes.covered: python3 -c "import importlib.util,sys; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lh','q-system/.q-system/scripts/launchd-health-check.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); print('\n'.join(p.rstrip('.') for p in m.load_watched_prefixes()))"

allow.reason: third-party app, not a fleet job
Pipit2 Sparkle auto-updater, a third-party app, not a fleet job
